evidence_class: SOURCE_CONFIRMED at best. Nothing in this file was observed at runtime; no application was started for this inventory.

findings.evidence: dashboard/src/components/layout/DashboardLayout.jsx:17-45 (grep -i 'skip' in dashboard/src and index.html found no skip link)
findings.finding: No skip-to-content link anywhere; keyboard users tab through the 20-link desktop sidebar and the StatsBar before reaching <main> on every route.

Single-character shortcuts A/R/S write a review decision immediately with no confirmation, no undo and no way to disable or remap (WCAG 2.1.4). The handler only ignores input/textarea/combobox targets, so the keys fire while focus is on any button or link on the page.

The review 'cursor' row that A/R/S act on is a non-focusable <div> styled by border only; it has no tabindex, aria-current/aria-selected or live announcement, so assistive-technology users cannot tell which record a shortcut will decide. It is also independent of DOM focus.

Toasts are plain <div>s with no role=status/alert or aria-live, yet they are the only success/failure feedback for review decisions, regulatory decisions, export, notify, hydromet refresh and API-key changes. The toast close button is icon-only with no accessible name and is opacity-0 until hover/focus.
Review Queue severity and tier Select triggers (role=combobox) have no aria-label. Same defect on the Live Logs type filter and the Outages type filter.

AI panel close button and send button are icon-only with no accessible name; the text input has only a placeholder; the panel is not a dialog/region, has no label and no focus management on open/close.

Mobile navigation is a full-screen fixed <aside> without role=dialog/aria-modal, focus is not moved into it or returned on close, and background content stays in the tab order. Group tabs use role=tab/tablist without tabpanel, aria-controls or arrow-key handling.

Map page uses a fixed 440px non-shrinking aside beside a flex-1 min-w-0 map with no responsive breakpoint, and a 250px layer panel over the map; at phone widths the map column collapses. Monitoring has the same pattern with a fixed 250px layer rail.
The main map container has no role or accessible name, and marker/polygon selection, hover popups and all spatial tools are pointer-only (map.on('click'/'mouseenter')).
78 focusable SVG municipio paths remove the focus outline (focus:outline-none) and provide no alternative focus style; they also add 78 tab stops with no roving tabindex.
Basemap Map/Satellite buttons expose the active choice by colour only (no aria-pressed), unlike the other layer toggles. Monitoring range buttons and water-layer rail buttons have the same gap.
Overview and Map routes render no <h1> (neither uses PageHeader); the desktop sidebar's <h2> group headings precede any page heading in DOM order.
WaterDisruption renders its own <main> inside the layout's <main>, producing nested main landmarks.
Mobile header and StatsBar are <div>s; there is no <header>/banner landmark. Backend-down banner has no role=alert/aria-live.

In the mobile drawer the top-level NavLink ignores isActive for styling (always 'text-xl text-sky-700'); the current page is conveyed only by react-router's implicit aria-current, with no visible indication for top-level items.
Several icon-only buttons rely on `title` alone for a name: Review CSV export, Review AI-suggest, Assets CSV export.
Review row selection and 'Select all on page' are plain buttons swapping icons; no role=checkbox/aria-checked/aria-pressed, and every row's button has the same name 'Select record'.

Regulatory 'Approve' is disabled when contradictions exist and the reason is given only through a title attribute on a disabled button (not focusable, not announced); the form itself gives no inline reason for disabled Reject/Needs-review when actor/rationale are empty.
text-slate-500/600 on slate-900/950 backgrounds is still used throughout for captions and metadata (previously measured 3.75:1 in docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md); not re-measured here.
Inline links inside slate-500 paragraph text are distinguished by colour only (no underline).
Controls are sized below 44px by class: h-7 (28px) review buttons, 16px select icons, px-2 py-1 map chips, p-1.5 hamburger.
Recharts charts on Analytics, Overview, Sector and Monitoring have no aria-label, summary or data table alternative (Sector has a separate asset table only).
No prefers-reduced-motion handling in app CSS; map easeTo/fly animations and animate-pulse/animate-spin are unconditional.
Search inputs with placeholder only: Live Logs filter, Outages search, Assets search, ProgramTimeline search; MonitoringCharts 'include polygon' checkbox label UNKNOWN (line 178 not opened in full).
Hand-written tables on Environmental Exposure, Hydromet and Source Intelligence use <th> without scope; Water Use / Hydro Inventory do set scope=row.

After a successful Entregar, load() sets loading=true and ListState swaps the whole list for skeletons, unmounting the focused button; nothing restores focus (no .focus() call exists in frontend/src). Keyboard and screen-reader users are dropped to the document start on a page that can hold hundreds of cards.

Handoff success is not announced: the confirmation span has no live region and is keyed to status 'delivered', which the backend never returns (it returns pending_ack/partial/failed). Only errors use role=alert.
Every card repeats the same button name 'Entregar' and the same group legend 'Destinos' with no reference to the item title, so controls are indistinguishable in a controls list.

ConfidenceBadge maps medium->warning and low->caution, HandoffStatusBadge maps watching->warning, onto @pr-federation/react 0.3.0 tones that the repo's own audit records as failing contrast. The mapping is unchanged and the package pin is unchanged; the CSS values themselves are not in the snapshot.

Below the md breakpoint the Pipeline card grid has one implicit auto column; each card is a grid item with default min-width:auto containing a nowrap (truncate) title, so a long title can widen the track past the viewport.
Home renders a <main> inside the shell's <main>, giving two nested main landmarks.
No skip-to-content link; on narrow screens the brand plus 8 nav links precede the content on every page.
Program timeline search input has no accessible name other than its placeholder; the wrapping label contains only an icon.
Filter chips (Pipeline domains, timeline phases) and the theme button convey selection by colour/glyph only; no aria-pressed or aria-current.

Pages bypass the i18n helper: Handoff is hard-coded Spanish, PipelineItemDetail, WaterDisruption, ProgramTimeline and ErrorBoundary are hard-coded English, while html lang follows the toggle. Content language can disagree with the declared language.
Pipeline and PipelineItemDetail loading, empty and backend-unreachable messages are plain elements without role=status/alert, unlike the ListState pages.
Topbar buttons are 34px high, the shadcn Button default is h-9 (36px), and Pipeline chips use py-1 text-sm; all below a 44px target.
Signals table has no caption and th cells have no scope; its horizontal scroll container is not keyboard focusable.
Badge explanations (confidence band, evidence tier, routing target) are exposed only through title attributes.
Dispatch error text uses text-red-700 with no dark-mode variant.
Sortable column headers are <th> elements with an onClick only: no tabIndex, no inner <button>, no key handler. Sorting in Contracts and Entities is pointer-only. aria-sort is set correctly.

TypeFilterSelect renders a Radix SelectTrigger with no aria-label and no associated label; used on Entities and Relationships. This is the button-name finding from docs/A11Y_AUDIT.md:105-114 and is still present in current source.
Dashboard root is a <div> with a <header>; there is no <main> element or role=main anywhere in the shipped app (grep '<main' in dashboard/src matches only the visual-test atlas).

Campaign Finance (3 tables), Ownership and Gov Changes build their header rows from TableCell (<td>) instead of TableHead (<th>), so columns have no header semantics. The change-candidates table has no header row at all.

Same issue in the ownership holders table and the government-changes table (dashboard/src/components/GovernmentChanges.jsx:29-34); dashboard/src/components/GovernmentChangeCandidates.jsx:11-20 has body rows only.

Contract and entity rows are <tr role="button" tabIndex=0>, which replaces row semantics for assistive tech, and use focus:outline-hidden with only a background tint as the focus indicator. Keyboard activation (Enter/Space) is implemented.

Activity search input sits in a <label> containing only an icon, so its accessible name comes from the placeholder alone; outline is removed (outline-hidden). Phase filter buttons expose selection by colour only (no aria-pressed).

Every ranking row has a button named just 'Inspect' (no entity in the name) at min-h-9 (36px, under the 44px target the federation harness requires); the ranking <table> has no caption and its <th> cells no scope.

Filter inputs/selects and the API-key Save button use h-7 (28px) heights: dashboard/src/components/ContractsTable.jsx:50, dashboard/src/components/EntitiesTable.jsx:50, dashboard/src/components/CampaignFinance.jsx:174,185,203, dashboard/src/components/OwnershipDeepDive.jsx:41, dashboard/src/components/ApiKeysPanel.jsx:48,53, dashboard/src/components/TypeFilterSelect.jsx:16.

API-key save failure is rendered as a plain

with no role=alert/aria-live.
Top Entities 'Loading ranking…' text has no role=status/aria-live (its error does have role=alert at line 93).
Theme is hard-coded to dark at boot and in index.html; no theme toggle or light theme in the shipped app.
recharts BarChart has no accessible name/description; the same counts are available as text in the list directly below (lines 47-53).

No automated accessibility check runs against any real dashboard tab. The only axe run targets the fixture page federation-pilot-atlas.html; vitest-axe matchers are registered (dashboard/src/test/setup.js:2-5) but no test calls axe()/toHaveNoViolations (grep in dashboard/src returns nothing).

At <=760px (which the 420px-wide desktop window reaches) the closed navigation panel is only translated off-screen; it is not display:none, visibility:hidden or inert. Its ~10+ buttons stay in the tab order and the accessibility tree, so keyboard focus disappears off-screen before reaching the page content. When open it is not a dialog: no focus move into it, no focus trap, no Escape, no close button, and the toggle keeps the label 'Open navigation'.

Functional, affects all users: runs with more than 500 events are reloaded with only the first 500 (see workflow stream-answer), which removes the tail of a long live-streamed answer and its citations.

The conversation menu declares role=menu/menuitem but implements none of the pattern: focus is not moved into it, there is no arrow-key navigation, Escape or outside-click close; it stays open until an item or the toggle is pressed.

The mode picker is a ul role=listbox whose children are plain li elements wrapping button role=option (invalid ownership), with no arrow keys, Escape or active-descendant; it works as a list of buttons by Tab only.

Sheet returns focus to the element focused when it mounted. For sheets opened from the conversation menu (Rename, Delete, Background tasks) that element is a menu item that has already been unmounted, so focus falls to the document body on close. Same for the approval card: after Allow/Deny the card unmounts and nothing receives focus.

The trap's focusable selector omits <summary> and matches elements inside closed <details> (e.g. pre[tabindex=0]). In sheets that end with disclosures (Tool activity, Evidence) the computed last item can be an unfocusable hidden element, so Tab from the last visible control can leave the dialog; the page behind is not inert or aria-hidden (aria-modal only).
Switching workspace does not move focus, change document.title or announce; a screen-reader user gets only aria-current on the pressed button. The page title is always 'Mucaro AI'.

A pending approval is announced through the polite live region ('Waiting for your approval.') but focus is not moved to the card and it is not a live region itself; the user must find it in the feed. Deny and Allow once are native buttons, so keyboard activation works.
Provenance, Sources, Memory and Background tasks show their empty text while the first load is still in flight (no loading state).

DirectoryIntake errors render in a div with no role=alert, its buttons have no type attribute, and the status badge is raw status code text; the section is titled 'Add a folder from this Mac' on every platform.
Rebuild index and the memory On/Off toggle have no error handling; a failure is invisible and inaudible.
When Adjust/Revise fails, the error text is rendered on the card behind the modal sheet, not inside it.

findings.evidence: frontend/src/App.jsx:238, frontend/index.html:2, frontend/src/styles.css:74-78, frontend/src/styles.css:1299, frontend/src/styles.css:24, frontend/src/styles.css:1317-1331
findings.finding: Present in source: skip link, lang=en, global :focus-visible outline, prefers-reduced-motion, prefers-color-scheme, 16px fields and 44px targets at <=900px or coarse pointers, labelled form fields, role=alert on errors, one polite live region.

On desktop the only ways to open a case are a mouse click on a <tr> that has no tabIndex, role or key handler, or a click on a map canvas point. The case detail cannot be opened from the keyboard or by a screen-reader user in the desktop shell.

A failed or still-pending /cases or /geojson request is presented as real emptiness ('0 of 0 cases', 'No cases found', '0 mapped sightings'). Only the small header text says 'backend unreachable'. Statistics and Candidates do distinguish the two states through QueryState.

The MapLibre container has no role or accessible name, and points, clusters and all three spatial tools respond only to pointer clicks. The Cases list is a text equivalent for the points themselves, but not for measure, buffer or nearest.

Both Recharts bar charts expose their per-decade and per-tier values only as SVG bars and hover tooltips; there is no table, list or accessibilityLayer. Only Total/Mapped/Unmapped are available as text.

Switching to Español sets <html lang='es'> while Statistics, Candidates, Activity, map controls, spatial tools, error states and the sheet 'Close' label stay English, so a screen reader pronounces them with the wrong language.

Evidence tier and confidence are bare badges ('T3', '0.2') with no visible or accessible label saying which is which; meaning is carried by position and colour. Confidence arrives as a number, so confidenceTone's high/medium/low palette never matches and every badge is slate.

CaseDetail sets no onCloseAutoFocus and is not opened from a focusable trigger on desktop (table row or map canvas), so focus has no meaningful element to return to on close. The More sheet does restore focus explicitly.
Programme-timeline phase filter buttons show the active filter by class only (no aria-pressed), the search input is named only by its placeholder, and decorative icons lack aria-hidden.

Controls reachable in the mobile shell without a 44px minimum: timeline filter and sort buttons (min-h-9), spatial-tool mode, radius and Clear buttons, the map 'Clear date filter' × and 'Retry density' link-button, the QueryState Retry button, and MapLibre's zoom control (no CSS override in index.css).
The case-list scroll container and the table wrapper are overflow-auto with no tabindex, so the region cannot be focused for keyboard scrolling.
The mobile branch wraps content in <main>; the desktop branch uses <div> and <aside> only. There is no skip link in either.
In the desktop table the 'no coordinates' icon passes a title prop to an SVG and has no aria-label, unlike the mobile card which uses aria-label.
The mapped-count legend and the spatial tools panel are both absolutely positioned at bottom-2 left-2 of the map area, so they occupy the same corner when tools are open.
The health dot conveys up/down by colour and pulse only; it is acceptable because the adjacent text (sr-only on mobile) states the same thing.
Mobile navigation toggle is an icon-only <button> (h-8 w-8 = 32x32 CSS px) with no aria-label, no visible/sr-only text, no aria-expanded, no aria-controls, no type attribute
Mobile nav overlay is a plain fixed div: no role=dialog/aria-modal, no focus move/trap/return, no Escape handler, backdrop is a click-only div; background content stays in tab order
SideDrawer (all 7 detail drawers) has no role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby; no focus trap; focus is not moved in on open nor returned on close. Only Escape + backdrop click are handled
SideDrawer close button is icon-only (X) with no accessible name; 32x32 px

Data-table rows open drawers via <tr onClick> with no tabIndex/role/keyboard handler: Dashboard.jsx:165, Observations.jsx:199, Aircraft.jsx:86, FR24Intake.jsx:76, Routes.jsx:262. Observation, capture and route detail (and their review actions) are unreachable by keyboard from these tables
Shared SearchInput has placeholder only - no label/aria-label (FilterSelect does have aria-label)
V4 recurrence inputs rely on placeholder only
role=tablist/tab with aria-selected but no role=tabpanel, aria-controls, roving tabindex or arrow-key support (FlightArchive.jsx:269-276; SkyTargetFinder.jsx:425-436)
Inputs/selects set focus:outline-hidden with only a faint border-colour change (focus:border-primary/50) as the focus indicator
Cards/Table view toggle conveys state by colour only (no aria-pressed)
Map feature inspection, console coordinate selection and spatial tools are map-click only; console map container is a div with aria-label but no role
ToastClose button is icon-only without accessible name
LoadingState spinner has no role=status/aria-live
No skip-to-content link; <nav> has no aria-label; page title/heading management on route change not found (ScrollToTop is unmounted)

Several controls are below 44px (and some below 24px): mobile toggle 32px (Layout.jsx:32), drawer close 32px (SideDrawer.jsx:24), copy-hash icon button h-3 w-3 with no padding (CaptureDetailDrawer.jsx:104)

vitest-axe is declared as a devDependency (frontend/package.json:101) but no test imports it (grep 'axe' in frontend/src and frontend/tests finds no vitest-axe usage); no axe/a11y assertion exists in the frontend suites

Single printable-character shortcuts ([, ], L) are global window listeners with no way to disable or remap them; they are suppressed only for INPUT/TEXTAREA/contentEditable, not for a focused <select> (type-ahead with 'l' in the flight or target-layer select also toggles the layer panel).
role=tablist/tab without arrow-key navigation or roving tabindex; every tab is a tab stop. aria-controls points at one shared panel.
Left-rail module buttons expose the active module only through data-active (no aria-current/aria-pressed), unlike the investigation buttons beside them.
Measure/Buffer/Nearest tools, access-point selection for drawn points and imagery footprint identify are driven only by map click events; there is no keyboard or list alternative for drawn records.
A running query has no status region: while pending with no tokens nothing is announced or shown except the button text changing to STOP; streamed RAG text is not in a live region.
Pipeline state is conveyed by button label and inline colour only (no aria-live); failure text is appended to a log that is visible only in the Query tab.
2D/3D toggle and ProgramTimeline phase filter buttons carry no aria-pressed (state via data-on / class only).
Alert feed and contracts table headers have no scope attribute; Finance table uses role=grid on rows that are focusable individually without grid arrow-key navigation.
Investigation graph connector SVG has no role/label and node buttons are absolutely positioned by percentage; reading order is DOM order only.
No skip-to-content link; keyboard users traverse command bar and (when open) the whole left rail before reaching the module.
Timeline slider aria-valuetext is the raw cursor string, empty until data loads.

method: Source reading only. No axe scan, screen reader or device was used for these rows; each is a lead to confirm at runtime.
